title: DPW Director
trigger_line: Recent flooding in Example Park likely drove a surge of resident calls to public works.

emails.subject: resident calls after the flooding
emails.body: After the recent flooding in the Borough of Example Park, I expect your public works office fielded a wave of the same resident questions: road closures, debris pickup, who to call. We build AI response systems, trained on your own notices and procedures, that answer those routine questions while your crew handles the real emergencies. Would a free 20-minute call be useful? I can also send a 2-minute Loom.

emails.subject: re: resident calls after the flooding
emails.body: A brief follow-up. Our systems are trained only on your own documents, installed in 21 days, and run with a named human operator, so staff remain in charge of every escalation. Our AI Audit is a low-risk first step if you want to look closer. The free 20-minute call is the easy start.

emails.subject: closing the loop
emails.body: Closing the loop on my end. If routine resident calls are still crowding out field work, you can pick a time at {{booking_link}}. Thank you for the work you do for the Borough.

linkedin_note: Marcus, after the recent flooding I imagine public works took a lot of repeat calls. I build AI systems that answer routine resident questions so crews can focus. Glad to connect, no pitch.
